VERDICT: BLOCKERS (1 release-gate blocker; no factual, source, contract, image, or brand-safety defects found)

=== BLOCKER 1: GPT review artifact is bound to a stale repository SHA; promotion is deterministically refused ===

Severity: release-gate failure (hard stop; not a content defect)
Evidence file: artifacts/editorial/reviews/gpt/things-to-do/surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing.07869bc01d3c.json
Gate code: apps/pipeline/review.py:148-157 (verify_gpt_review), enforced from apps/pipeline/publish.py:214 (promote_candidate)

- GPT artifact repositorySha: 6dd6b08cefcb2ff566bceba5456d8c44c01bb6fc
- Actual HEAD / SHA under review: 7236d0dc8eb86cee6194a3e72c6c37ac87e0048e

verify_gpt_review shells out to `git rev-parse HEAD` and raises when the artifact's repositorySha differs. I executed the real gate against the exact candidate and artifact:

    GPT GATE FAILED: PermissionError GPT review was created for a different repository SHA

promote_candidate calls verify_gpt_review as its FIRST operation, before verify_claude_review, so this raises before any Claude release review is consulted. Returning NO BLOCKERS would authorize a promotion the pipeline itself will refuse to execute.

Root cause (sequencing slip, not a content problem): all three GPT reviews for this slug ran against the working-tree candidate while HEAD was still 6dd6b08 (all three artifacts carry repositorySha 6dd6b08). Commit 7236d0d then staged the candidate .mdx AND all three review artifacts together, moving HEAD past the reviewed SHA. Confirmed: `git show 6dd6b08:.../surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing.mdx` -> "exists on disk, but not in '6dd6b08'". The passing artifact is therefore bound to a repository state that did not contain the candidate at all.

Precedent confirms the intended ordering. Every previously PROMOTED article's passing artifact binds to a commit that contains the exact candidate:
- darts-hill-scavenger-hunt-surrey: candidate bef499b3 @ repositorySha 4b7fbcd -> git show 4b7fbcd:<candidate> hashes to bef499b3 (MATCH)
- surrey-clayton-coffee-house-friday: candidate 6189c6f7 @ repositorySha 48f605ea (MATCH)
- bc-halal-food-fest-cloverdale-final-day: candidate f3c80eba @ repositorySha 2c19e886 (MATCH)
The darts-hill trail shows the exact working sequence: commit 4b7fbcd contained the repaired candidate, GPT reviewed at that HEAD, promotion ran at that same HEAD, and the PASS artifact + published content file were committed together afterward in 9fcf9b9 ("Publish Darts Hill scavenger hunt bulletin"). Only GPT-BLOCKED candidates (surrey-fence-art @ 2f5d4a09) carry a repositorySha lacking the candidate, because those never exercised the promote gate.

This also matches the written rule in CLAUDE.md line 15: "the artifact must match the exact candidate and repository hashes."

REMEDIATION (no content change required): re-run the GPT editorial review with HEAD at 7236d0d, then generate the Claude release review at that same HEAD, then promote BEFORE committing anything further (committing the new artifacts first would move HEAD again and re-break both gates). Because the body is byte-identical, candidateSha256 remains 07869bc01d3c... and the re-run overwrites the same artifact path surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing.07869bc01d3c.json. Note that apps/pipeline/review.py:76 imposes the identical repositorySha==HEAD constraint on the Claude artifact, so both must be produced at the promotion-time HEAD.

=== GATES THAT PASS CLEANLY ===

1. EXACT CANDIDATE HASH - PASS
   sha256(artifacts/editorial/release-candidates/things-to-do/surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing.mdx)
   = 07869bc01d3c3cd1d8bd335288dd124a96cd535f09901b7b1f417141d07d01fe
   Matches the expected hash and the artifact's candidateSha256 exactly. Working tree clean; all candidate assets (mdx, image, 3 review artifacts, 4 research artifacts, 3 metrics artifacts) are tracked at HEAD.

2. GPT SCORECARD CONTENT - PASS
   verdict PASS; engagement 4, factualSupport 5, formatting 5, quality 4, readability 4 (all >= 4 threshold from config release.gptEditorialMinimumScore); blockers []; proseEmDashCount 0; reviewBackend codex-cli-oauth (approved set); reviewRunId 019fa140-61d9-7cf0-8c55-1b0e75a2ea53 present; modelUsed gpt-5.6-sol (gpt- prefix). All checks in review.py:116-142 satisfied.
   Repair trail is genuine and the defects are resolved: artifact f9a52c5a blocked an unsupported "guaranteed seat" claim; artifact 392fb7dd blocked a repetitive "Why this one is useful" section and a generic close. Neither defect survives in the final text.

3. SOURCE SUPPORT - PASS (every claim verified)
   The live URL returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so I verified against the committed capture artifacts/editorial/research/2026-07-26-1830-surrey-sounds-source.html (121,041 bytes, City of Surrey page). Verbatim source support for every article assertion:
   - "July 29, 2026 6:30pm - 8:00pm" -> date + time claims (H2 list and highlights)
   - "Surrey Civic Plaza (13450 104 Avenue)" -> venue + address
   - "Free (No ticket required)" -> price claim and highlight
   - "A free interactive concert as part of the Sounds of Summer outdoor concert series featuring The Boot Scooters with line dancing instruction" -> lead, series framing, "outdoor"
   - "high-energy collective of seasoned touring session musicians and professional dancers" -> performer description
   - "interactive line dancing, two-stepping, and boot-scootin' sessions" -> instruction claim
   - "perfect for all ages and skill levels ... whether you're a seasoned dancer or a total beginner" -> "beginners can take part instead of only watching"
   - "Seating is limited, bring your own chair." -> seating claim + checklist item
   - "Washrooms are available at Surrey City Hall." -> washroom claim
   - "Paid parking. The parkade at Surrey City Hall..." -> parking claim + checklist item
   - "Concert sites can be crowded, it is recommended to leave your pet at home." -> pets claim
   - "Service animals are permitted / Accessible parking available at Surrey City Hall ... / Accessible washrooms available at Surrey City Hall" -> accessibility claim
   - "If you pack a picnic ... pack out all your waste ... sort it into the appropriate waste streams at home." -> food claim
   - "Alcohol is not permitted in unlicensed public spaces at any time." -> alcohol claim
   Calendar check: 2026-07-29 is a Wednesday (title/lead claim correct); 2026-07-26 is a Sunday (publishedAt day). No overstatement, no invented detail, no unsupported guarantee anywhere in the body.

4. ARTICLE CONTRACT - PASS
   Executed validate_release_candidate() from apps/pipeline/validation.py with the real config/content-business.json contract: PASSED: True, zero errors.
   - Word count 333 (bulletin wordRange 300-600) - near the floor but inside
   - H2 sections 4 (minimumH2 3)
   - List items 15 (minimumLists 2)
   - Prose em dashes 0 (also confirmed independently: `node utils/em-dash-validator.js` exit 0, "No em dashes found in article prose")
   - Highlights 4, all unique (formatting min/max satisfied)
   - Internal article links 0 (bulletin internalLinks range 0-1; 0 is legal, so no forbidden-anchor / self-link / unresolved-link exposure)
   - Source URL present in body; primary source present; locality "Surrey" set; lengthRationale and reportingMethod present
   - No "location promise" trigger in title/subtitle/readerImpact, so the find-or-location section rule does not apply

5. FRONTMATTER / IMAGE - PASS
   Frontmatter field set matches the promoted darts-hill precedent exactly, with status "release-candidate" correctly still in place (publish.py:236 requires it, and promote_candidate is what rewrites it to "published" while injecting editorialReview*/review*/candidateSha256/promotedAt). Absence of those review fields pre-promotion is correct, not a defect.
   Image /images/editorial/2026/07/surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing.png exists at public/, is tracked at HEAD, 2,378,429 bytes, 1672x941 RGB PNG (16:9, consistent with sibling editorial images). I viewed it: line dancers in cowboy boots and hats on a plaza in front of a live band on stage, modern glass civic building behind, golden-hour light. On-topic, photorealistic, no readable text, no logos, no identifiable-person or trademark risk. Accurately described by imageAlt "People line dancing at an outdoor summer concert in a civic plaza". imageAttribution declares AI provenance. Not a placeholder.
   readingTime 2 is plausible for 333 words.

6. BRAND SAFETY / SENSITIVITY / SPONSORSHIP - PASS
   Zero hits against all 22 manualApprovalKeywords in config/local-news-sources.json (checked case-insensitively over the full file, including the "Alcohol is not permitted" line, which matches no keyword). manualApprovalRequired false is correct, so brandSafety must be "standard" - and it is (validation.py:249-253).
   sponsorshipStatus "editorial" equals monetization.automatedDefaultSponsorshipStatus, so no recorded owner approval is required; commercialApprovalRecorded false is consistent. commercialIntent "ad-fit" is in commercialIntentValues, commercialFitReason present and correctly marks audience/RPM/revenue/sponsor metrics as unavailable rather than inventing zeroes.

7. SEO / CANONICAL / PROMOTION RISK - PASS
   slug "surrey-sounds-summer-line-dancing" matches the filename; category "things-to-do" is a valid publisher category with an existing populated content/things-to-do/ tree. No existing published article mentions "Sounds of Summer" or "Boot Scooters" (grep over content/ returns nothing), so there is no duplicate or cannibalization risk, and no destination-file collision at content/things-to-do/.
   publishedAt 2026-07-26T18:45:00-07:00 is consistent with the 18:30 sweep window.
   Sweep/daily ceiling: 2 articles published today (darts-hill 08:40, bc-halal 08:15); the 10:30/12:30/14:30/16:30 sweeps published zero. At 2 of 6 daily and 0 of 2 for this sweep, the candidate is within both caps.
   Release config permits routine autonomous promotion (publicPublishingRequiresHumanAuthorization false, routineEditorialPublishingAuthorized true), so the PermissionError above is attributable solely to the repositorySha mismatch, not to a disabled authorization flag.

=== BOTTOM LINE ===
The editorial work is release-quality: factually airtight against the primary source, contract-compliant, well-imaged, and brand-safe. But the exact candidate CANNOT be promoted autonomously at repository SHA 7236d0d, because the repository's own promote gate raises PermissionError on the stale repositorySha binding in the passing GPT artifact. Per CLAUDE.md, blockers require repair plus fresh GPT and Claude reviews. Re-run the GPT review at HEAD 7236d0d, produce the Claude review at that same HEAD, and promote before committing further work.
